Dossier of one file's pending items (gates + doctor), for batch fixing.

```text
Gathers, for one file, EVERYTHING pending on it:
  • the quality gates that apply to its kind (what 'check' would run)
  • the systemic findings from 'doctor' that cite it (collision, orphan, identity…)

Default: the file itself only. With --impact, includes the nodes on the impact path
(the unit's pieces and what the target propagates/validates) — to fix the whole unit.

Designed for PARALLEL sweeping: one agent per file, 'anchors audit <file>',
fixes all the pending items at once (header, spec, identity, coverage…).
```

## Uso

```bash
anchors audit <file> [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Padrão | O que faz |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--impact` |  | includes the impact path (the whole unit), not just the file |
| `--map` |  | path to the map |
| `--root` | `.` | project root |

Comandos da mesma família — o que distingue cada um:

| Comando | O que faz |
| --- | --- |
| [`anchors doctor`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/doctor/) | X-ray of the ecosystem: systemic loose ends, health and maturity |
| **`anchors audit`** | Dossier of one file's pending items (gates + doctor), for batch fixing |
| [`anchors status`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/status/) | Where the project stands in the cycle, and what the next step is |
| [`anchors task-status`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/task-status/) | The round's report: what is delivered, what remains, and what comes next |

| [`anchors governs`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/governs/) | Show who each guide governs (and how many) — sizes the audit per guide |
